_comment: Copy this to catalog.json, replace it with the real discography, then run:
The import is idempotent and keyed on `id`: running it again updates existing
entries rather than duplicating them, so this file can stay the source of truth
and be re-imported after every edit.
Leave `coverUrl` null to use the generated sleeve — the app derives a facet
composition from the title, so a release without artwork still looks intentional.

news.title: ZEITGEIST is out now
news.body: The new single is available on every major platform.
